newsitem.title: USA: BankAmerica Corp Q4 net rises.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica Corp Q4 net rises.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Diluted shr is $1.92 vs $1.74 in Q4 and $7.30 vs $6.45 for year.
Q4 and year 1996 net include $147 million gain on issuance of subsidiary's stock. Gain increased Q4 1996 EPS $0.40.
Q4 and year 1996 net include $280 million restructuring charge. Charge decreased Q4 1996 EPS by $0.46.
Year 1996 net includes $82 million SAIF charge from Q3. Year EPS excluding charge is $7.44 ($7.43 diluted).
Net gain on sale of assets was $63 million vs $29 million in Q4, and $197 million vs $71 million for year.
Net gain on sale of subsidiaries was $5 million vs $42 million in Q4, and $197 million vs $71 million for year.
Q4 1996 credit loss provision $220 million, down $15 million from Q3 1996.
Q4 net credit losses $207 million, down $19 million from Q3 1996.
